def transform(g):
    bg = max(set(x for r in g for x in r) - {2}, key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in g))
    mk = [x for x in set(x for r in g for x in r) - {2, bg}][0]
    dr=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==2 for x in r)]
    dc=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(len(g)))]
    rs=[s for s in [0]+[d+1 for d in dr] if s<len(g)]
    cs=[s for s in [0]+[d+1 for d in dc] if s<len(g[0])]
    re_=[e for e in dr+[len(g)] if e not in dr or True]
    rb=[(a,(b)) for a,b in zip(rs, dr+[len(g)])]
    cb=[(a,b) for a,b in zip(cs, dc+[len(g[0])])]
    return [[1 if sum(g[r][c]==mk for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))==2 else 9
             for x,y in cb] for a,b in rb]

def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mk=[x for x in cnt if x!=2 and x!=bg][0]
    dr=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==2 for x in r)]
    dc=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j]==2 for i in range(len(g)))]
    rs=[0]+[d+1 for d in dr]; cs=[0]+[d+1 for d in dc]
    rb=list(zip(rs,dr+[len(g)])); cb=list(zip(cs,dc+[len(g[0])]))
    return [[1 if sum(g[r][c]==mk for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))==2 else bg
             for x,y in cb] for a,b in rb]
